# Abdul Jaleel Kavungal — studio portfolio

> Studio portfolio of open work in trustworthy AI, agent systems, and secure software.

## Selected work

- [Aletheia](https://abduljaleel.xyz/aletheia/): The unconcealment layer for autonomous agents — twelve products on one stack.
- [ax](https://abduljaleel.xyz/ax/): The AI coding agent built without the trade-offs.
- [EvolveHandsAI](https://abduljaleel.xyz/EvolveHandsAI/): Code that breeds better code — an evolutionary code engine.
- [VIM](https://abduljaleel.xyz/vim/): Vulnerability Inheritance Map.
- [Wharf](https://abduljaleel.xyz/wharf/): A dock for your Managed Agents.
- [X-Road](https://abduljaleel.xyz/X-Road/): Secure data exchange that watches, predicts, and explains itself.
- [LoopbackCloud](https://abduljaleel.xyz/loopbackcloud/): The local cloud for AI agents — AWS, Azure and GCP on localhost.
